name: connective tissue disease overview
title: Connective tissue diseases: the signature feature sorts lupus and antiphospholipid syndrome, Sjogren's syndrome, inflammatory myositis and systemic sclerosis; each column gives presentation, the antibodies and tests in order, and treatment, with Raynaud's and lupus care below

nodes.title: Woman, several organs, often Raynaud's: which connective tissue disease?
lines: all more common in women · most are antinuclear antibody (ANA) positive
ANA negative → lupus highly unlikely · ANA positive alone proves nothing (the commonest cause: NO cause)
connective tissue (cells in a collagen, elastin matrix) is in every organ · also mixed connective tissue disease
any of them: interstitial lung disease, Raynaud's, positive ANA (not specific)

nodes.title: Rash in the sun, mouth ulcers, organs, or CLOTS
Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE)
lines: 1 in 1000 · women 9:1 · young
genes (HLA-DR2, DR3, complement) + smoking, infection, UV, silica, hormones, drugs
more cell death + SLOW clearance of nuclear debris → autoantibodies
drug-induced: milder · joints, skin, serositis

nodes.title: Antiphospholipid syndrome (APS)
lines: half with SLE · in 10-20% of SLE
primary (no other disease) or secondary

nodes.title: Sjögren's syndrome
lines: 2 in 10,000 · lymphocytes in exocrine glands

nodes.title: Inflammatory myositis
lines: 1 in 100,000 · shoulders, hips, neck
case: can't get out of bed, new Raynaud's, knuckle rash, CK ↑

nodes.title: Systemic sclerosis (scleroderma)
lines: 1 in 10,000 · highest mortality

nodes.title: Classify: ≥ 4 of 11, over 6 weeks
lines: • malar rash (spares the nasolabial folds), discoid, photosensitive
• mouth or nose ulcers · non-erosive arthritis
~ Raynaud's, hair loss common but NOT criteria
• malar vs rosacea: rosacea does NOT spare the folds
• subacute cutaneous lupus: trunk, arms, face spared · anti-Ro

nodes.title: Organs
lines: • pleurisy, pericarditis · nephritis (class IV diffuse proliferative worst)
• seizure, psychosis · counts ↓ (autoantibodies)
• livedo reticularis, vasculitic rash

nodes.title: RECURRENT clots or pregnancy loss
lines: • venous (deep vein thrombosis) or arterial
• livedo reticularis (lacy, flat, comes and goes) · platelets ↓
• catastrophic: 'thrombotic storm', many organs

nodes.title: Dry eyes + dry mouth (sicca)
lines: • gritty eyes, worse through the day
• dry food hard to swallow, taste, speech, bad breath
• dental caries · parotid, submandibular swelling

nodes.title: Beyond the glands
lines: • Raynaud's · purpura on the shins (leukocytoclastic vasculitis)
• arthritis · neuropathy · rarely lung disease

nodes.title: Dermatomyositis
lines: • children, older adults · may be cancer
• heliotrope · Gottron's papules (raised) or sign (flat)
• V-neck, cape, photosensitive · dilated nail-fold capillaries
• mechanic's hands · livedo · calcinosis

nodes.title: Polymyositis
lines: any age · NO rash · not cancer-linked

nodes.title: Fibrosis + vessels + autoimmunity
lines: • Raynaud's, reflux in nearly all · many dysphagia
• tight fingers (sclerodactyly) · digital ulcers: half ever
case: retrosternal dysphagia, tight hands, arms, face, basal crackles, nucleolar ANA, Scl-70

nodes.title: Limited or diffuse
lines: • LIMITED: below elbows, knees (fingers, face) · old CREST · anticentromere 50% · rarely kidney, heart
• DIFFUSE: + upper arms, thighs, trunk · nucleolar ANA 50%, Scl-70 30% · higher mortality

nodes.title: 1 · ANA: positive in > 95%
lines: + blood count, ESR, creatinine, urinalysis · ± ENA

nodes.title: 2 · ONLY if ANA + → anti-DNA
lines: • anti-Smith (extractable antigens)
• complement C3, C4 (CH50) low
case: 22 F, malar rash, sun rash, Raynaud's, hair loss, stiff hands · WBC 2.8, Hb 111, platelets 43 · ANA 1/320 speckled, anti-Sm +, anti-DNA −, C3, C4 low

nodes.title: Antibodies, PERSISTENT
lines: • anticardiolipin
• lupus anticoagulant (clotting time falsely ↑)
• false-positive syphilis test (VDRL) · Russell viper venom time

nodes.title: ANA 80-90% · rheumatoid factor 90%
lines: • anti-Ro, anti-La
• ESR very high: polyclonal immunoglobulins ↑
• anemia of chronic disease, white cells ↓

nodes.title: 1 · Rule out mimics FIRST
lines: • drugs: statins, steroids, colchicine, hydroxychloroquine, cyclosporine
• alcohol · thyroid, parathyroid, adrenal · K ↑↓, phosphate ↓, magnesium ↓
• sarcoid · infection · cancer

nodes.title: 2 · Creatine kinase ↑ · ANA 80%
lines: ESR ↑ in half
anti-Jo-1 (very specific) → lung disease, bad prognosis
antisynthetase: myositis, arthralgia, Raynaud's, mechanic's hands, lung disease
PM/Scl → scleroderma overlap

nodes.title: ANA > 95%
lines: • Scl-70 → lung fibrosis
• RNA polymerase → renal crisis
• limited: pulmonary hypertension late, older
15% rule: lung disease, pulmonary hypertension, arthritis, Sjögren's, myositis, current digital ulcer, renal crisis (diffuse)

nodes.title: Hydroxychloroquine for EVERY patient
lines: the anchor: skin, joints, fewer MAJOR flares

nodes.title: Minor organ (skin, joints)
lines: • topical or low-dose steroid
• anti-inflammatories (NSAIDs) · methotrexate

nodes.title: Major organ → high-dose steroid + immune suppressant
lines: mycophenolate, azathioprine, cyclophosphamide · belimumab (B cells)
~ steroid harm: avascular necrosis, osteoporosis, glucose

nodes.title: Antibody, no event
lines: nothing or aspirin (ASA) 81 mg

nodes.title: Catastrophic → IV heparin + IV steroids
lines: ± plasmapheresis or IV immunoglobulin

nodes.title: Watch: B-cell lymphoma (MALT)
lines: the higher risk

nodes.title: High-dose steroids
lines: then steroid-sparing: azathioprine, methotrexate, cyclophosphamide, IVIG, rituximab
prevent steroid osteoporosis

nodes.title: Danger
lines: • swallowing (aspiration) · heart (arrhythmia) · lung or diaphragm
• lung disease: treat aggressively
• cancer (older, dermatomyositis): ovary, stomach, lung, cervix adenocarcinoma

nodes.title: Raynaud's
lines: • avoid cold · stop smoking
• nifedipine (calcium channel blocker)
• then PDE5 inhibitor, topical nitrate, IV iloprost

nodes.title: Renal crisis: blood pressure ↑, hemolysis, kidneys fail
lines: → ACE inhibitor; > 80% die if missed · ± dialysis
early progressing diffuse · may be the FIRST sign

nodes.title: Treat the organ involved
lines: methotrexate softens skin in early diffuse
severe early diffuse: stem cell transplant
deaths: lung fibrosis, pulmonary hypertension, heart

panels.title: Raynaud's: primary or secondary?
items: white, then red or blue, reversible · 3% of everyone · 25-98% of CTD, > 95% of scleroderma
primary: no disease, often no drug needed · secondary: SLE, scleroderma, RA, Sjögren's, myositis
Raynaud's + dilated nailfold capillaries + anticentromere → ⅓ get scleroderma in 5 years

panels.title: Every lupus patient
items: education, rest · sun avoidance, SPF 30 · physio, OT
cardiovascular risk (50× events): smoking, blood pressure, lipids, diabetes · clotting risk
die of cardiovascular events, infection, SLE, drug complications

panels.title: Lupus classification (ACR 1982: ≥ 4 of 11)
items: skin: malar · discoid (scaly, plugged, SCARS) · photosensitive · mouth or nose ulcers (witnessed)
arthritis (non-erosive) · serositis · kidney (glomerulonephritis, nephrotic) · seizure or psychosis (no drug, metabolic cause)
blood: hemolytic anemia (Coombs +) · WBC < 4.0 or lymphocytes < 1.5 twice · platelets < 100 · ANA · anti-DNA, anti-Sm or antiphospholipid
2019 EULAR/ACR: ANA ≥ 1/80 to enter, then ≥ 10 points
